entities.name: Postmodernism & Deconstruction
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Intellectual movements questioning grand narratives, objective truth, and fixed meaning. Derrida's deconstruction, Foucault's power-knowledge analysis, and Lyotard's incredulity toward metanarratives challenged Enlightenment certainties and transformed literary criticism, architecture, philosophy, and social theory.
